releaseNotes: v5.1.5 — Screenshot Reader now understands the MT5 Navigator Accounts list: give it an Accounts screenshot and, with "Fill an account" chosen, it fills the account (number, name, firm) instead of erroring "could not read any trade" — the logged-in account is pre-selected, or pick another from the list. The "Trade Position and Back Testing Tool" chart title is no longer mistaken for a trade row. Same silent /S in-app update as v5.1.4 and same main-process OCR as v5.1.3.
